name: Go Down Swinging
description:
While your current Endurance is less than half your base Endurance:

  • Your current Defense increases by your BODY score.

  • Each time you attack, you gain +1d to either the attack roll or the damage roll, your choice.

Describe how you become more dangerous.

improvements.name: Nothing To Lose
improvements.description: Double the effects of this ability when your current Endurance is equal or less than ¼ your maximum Endurance.
